column3: “Words” renders singular word, and coming renders falling from heaven.
Feeding him is expressed as his own feeding; “an ox” renders plural oxen.
“Sentence” specifies word; feathers and claws supply the points of comparison, and the plural animals are singular.
“Sanity” specifies understanding; blessing, praising, and honoring become praising, honoring, and glorifying.
“Peoples” renders inhabitants; restraining His hand renders striking it.
